scripts.start: docker compose up --build -d && docker compose logs -f backend
scripts.restart: docker compose down && docker compose up --build -d && docker compose logs -f backend
scripts.start-db-dash: docker start pgadmin4 || docker run -d --name pgadmin4 -p 9090:80 -e PGADMIN_DEFAULT_EMAIL=admin@admin.com -e PGADMIN_DEFAULT_PASSWORD=admin dpage/pgadmin4
scripts.test-server: docker compose up -d postgres && (cd backend && set -a && source ../.env && set +a && DB_URL="${DB_URL/@postgres:/@127.0.0.1:}" go test -tags=integration -v ./...)
